title: FOUNDRY / REAL CENTER
claim: Tests a slow canonical-candidate layer (center/laws/convergences) against live control state without promoting current heads, fronts or the recovered project corpus into the definition of the endeavour.
known_limits: CANON_CANDIDATE is a draft status, not an irreversible declaration.
Convergence names compress cross-lineage patterns and should be revised if they erase distinct mechanisms.
Live heads and fronts are fetched from control state and may change independently of the slow model.
The recovered federation / project corpus remains a non-canonical donor corpus; no hard project count is canonical without a current census address.
CENTER LAB is an explanatory geometry/projection probe; triangle centers carry no canonical semantic meaning unless an explicit criterion justifies the mapping.

current_classification.basis: Its own receipt says CANON_CANDIDATE is a draft orientation layer, not an irreversible declaration.
